mechanisms.name: Gap junctions as innexin channels: conductance per EM contact = open channels x innexin unitary conductance (one shared value; no per-innexin measurement found); no junction where a partner expresses no innexin in CeNGEN. wiring=cook neuron-neuron gaps only. Rectification by innexin pair is not modelled: 923 of 1091 pairs could pair UNC-7 with UNC-9 by expression, so expression does not pick out the rectifying ones
